newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish net reserves fall to $21.09 bln in March.
newsitem.headline: Polish net reserves fall to $21.09 bln in March.

text.p: Polish net foreign currency reserves fell by $460 million in March to $21.09 billion and were $950 million lower than a year ago, the National Bank of Poland said.
It said official reserves fell $573 million in the January-March period compared to a $1.6 billion rise in the corresponding period of last year.
POLISH RESERVES (bln dollars) MARCH 97 FEB 97 MARCH 96
NOTE - Figures in billions of dollars. Official reserves are those held by the state. Net reserves mean the total amount of hard currencies in the whole banking system.
